repos_data.description: A lightweight macOS selection translator built with pure Swift 6, featuring on-device Apple Translate for privacy, only 5MB install size and stable ~50MB memory usage. 一款轻量级 macOS 划词翻译工具，纯 Swift 6 开发，设备端 Apple 翻译保护隐私，安装体积仅 5MB，后台运行内存稳定约 50MB

Real-time system audio translation for macOS — translate any audio (YouTube, podcasts, meetings) live on screen with OpenAI or Google Gemini. On-device speech recognition; optional low-latency realtime mode.
Screen translation app for macOS — select any area, get instant translation. On-device by default with Apple Vision OCR + Apple Translation.

Lingarr is an application that supports both local and SaaS translation services to translate subtitle files into a specified target language. With automated translation options, Lingarr simplifies translating subtitles.
GitHub action that translates any text to any language supported by chosen provider.
Localization/I18n: Incrementally update/translate your Strings files from .swift, .h, .m(m), .storyboard or .xib files.
Ready-to-use OCR with 80+ supported languages and all popular writing scripts including Latin, Chinese, Arabic, Devanagari, Cyrillic and etc.
OneClip——A simple and professional native clipboard manager for macOS ｜简单专业的macOS原生剪贴板工具｜还支持轻量级截图/长截图、OCR、划词翻译、拖拽容器、堆栈、PopClip、AI 集成、剪贴板同步等
🚀 BarTranslate, a handy (free) menu bar translator widget for macOS.
A macOS voice, screenshot, clipboard, and coding-agent workbench.
Simple macOS editor app to help you manage iOS and macOS app localizations by allowing you to edit all the translations side by side
基于 ChatGPT API 的划词翻译浏览器插件和跨平台桌面端应用    -    Browser extension and cross-platform desktop application for translation based on ChatGPT API.

repo_meta_data.description: 一个简洁优雅的词典翻译 macOS App。开箱即用，支持离线 OCR 识别，支持有道词典，🍎 苹果系统词典，🍎 苹果系统翻译，OpenAI，Gemini，DeepL，Google，Bing，腾讯，百度，阿里，小牛，彩云和火山翻译。A concise and elegant Dictionary and Translator macOS App for looking up words and translating text.
